test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two boys are standing on the opposite ends of a 540 metres long bridge. If they start walking towards each other at same time at the speed of 18 metres/minute and 12 metres/minute respectively, then in how much time will they meet each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance of the bridge = 540 metres

Speed of the first boy = 18 metres/minute

Speed of the second boy = 12 metres/minute

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = Speed of the first boy + Speed of the second boy

Relative Speed = 18 + 12

Relative Speed = 30 metres/minute

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 540 / 30

⇒ Time = 18 minutes

**They will meet each other in 18 minutes.**
